caption: Boiling water is poured into a collapsed vacuum-packed camping meal pouch, and the pouch swells and stands up.

sa.check: Boiling water is poured into the pouch.
The pour comes first and the swelling follows.

pc.expect: The pouch stays one bag whose flat sides bow out as it fills and which stands on its base once full.
pc.fail: The pouch keeps its flat collapsed shape while plainly full and standing; or the pouch swells into a ball far larger than its seams allow; or the pouch splits into separate bags; or the pouch turns into another object.

pc.expect: The pouch only fills and rises while the water goes in and does not collapse again with the water in it.
pc.fail: The pouch collapses flat again while still full; or the pouch fills and flattens in turn; or the pouch stands up before any water is poured; or the water's level drops while pouring goes on.

pc.expect: The water falls downward from the kettle into the pouch, lies in its base and the steam rises from the opening.
pc.fail: The water travels upward from the kettle; or the water gathers at the pouch's top and stays; or the steam pours downward out of the opening; or the pouch rises off the ground as it fills.

pc.expect: The pouch is a limp foil bag that creases and bulges and holds the water, and the water is a thin liquid that finds its level.
pc.fail: The pouch stays a rigid box as it fills; or the pouch stretches like elastic; or the water stands in a heap above the pouch's opening; or the pouch sets hard once full.

pc.expect: One pouch and one pour; the water goes from the kettle into the pouch and nowhere else.
pc.fail: Water appears in the pouch with no stream reaching it; or the water passes through the pouch's wall; or a second pouch appears; or the pouch vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pouch's printing, the kettle and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pouch's printing changes; or the kettle changes shape; or items around the pouch rearrange.
